description: TlsrptRecorder::record_failure calls self.records.lock().expect('mutex poisoned'). MtaStsEnforcer uses unwrap_or_else(|p| p.into_inner()) throughout — recovering the mutex state on poison rather than panicking. When TlsrptRecorder is eventually wired into the delivery path (stoa-3xdjv.3), a panic in another task that held the recorder lock would kill the delivery worker. Change expect() to unwrap_or_else(|p| p.into_inner()) for consistency and resilience.
title: TlsrptRecorder::record_failure uses expect on mutex — inconsistent with MtaStsEnforcer
